    Thai Dolby Digital 5.1
  • Case type:
    Special Case
  • Notes:
    DISC TWO is region A+B. All other discs are region ALL.
    Disc eight and nine extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    The box includes
    - 8 artcards
    - 68 page comic
    - 4 miniposters
    - "MAKING DREAMS & NIGHTMARES COME TRUE" book
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 9, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 9, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 9, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 9, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Notes:
    Comes in a cardboard slipcase with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish, Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    Special Case
  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Facehugger Packaging.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 9, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 9, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.

  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Facehugger Packaging.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
    Also available in a Nostromo Limited Edition Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Norwegian, Portuguese (Brazilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish
  • Aspect Ratio:
    1.85:1
  • Picture Format:
    1080p24 AVC MPEG-4
  • Soundtrack(s):
    English DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1
    English Dolby Digital 4.1 (Theatrical version only)
    English Dolby Digital 2.0 Surround
    French DTS 5.1
    German DTS 5.1
    Portuguese (Brazilian) Dolby Digital 5.1
    Spanish (Latin) Dolby Digital 5.1
  • Case type:
    Special Case
  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    Cantonese, English, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin (Traditional), Tagalog, Thai
  • Aspect Ratio:
    1.85:1
  • Picture Format:
    1080p24 AVC MPEG-4

    English DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1
    Italian DTS 5.1
    Japanese DTS 5.1
    Thai Dolby Digital 5.1
  • Case type:
    Special Case
  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    1.85:1

    1080p24 AVC MPEG-4

    English DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1
    Italian DTS 5.1
    Japanese DTS 5.1
    Thai Dolby Digital 5.1
  • Case type:
    Special Case
  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
    Also available in a Nostromo Limited Edition Packaging.
    Also available in a H.R. Giger Edition which also includes art cards, the original comic, 4 miniposters, and collectible prints.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    Cantonese, English, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin (Traditional), Tagalog, Thai

    1.85:1
  • Picture Format:
    1080p24 AVC MPEG-4

    English DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1
    Italian DTS 5.1
    Japanese DTS 5.1
    Thai Dolby Digital 5.1
  • Case type:
    Special Case
  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Facehugger Packaging.

    Also available in a Nostromo Limited Edition Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Facehugger Packaging.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
    Also available in a Nostromo Limited Edition Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    English DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1

  • Case type:
    Special Case
  • Notes:
    Comes with a 20-page booklet containing a letter from Ridley Scott and an overview of the Extras.
    All disc five and six extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    Also available in a Limited Edition Egg Packaging.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 6, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 6, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 6, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 8, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 8, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 8, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 8, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 9, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 9, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 9, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 9, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Notes:
    DISC TWO is region A+B. All other discs are region ALL.
    Disc eight and nine extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    The box includes Art of Prometheus exclusive book extracts.
    Exclusively available at Amazon.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 9, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 9, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

  • Subtitles:
    Arabic, Bulgarian, Croatian, English, Estonian, Hebrew, Kazakh, Latvian, Lithuanian, Romanian, Russian, Slovenian, Spanish (Castilian), Turkish, Ukrainian
  • Aspect Ratio:
    1.85:1
  • Picture Format:
    1080p24 AVC MPEG-4
  • Soundtrack(s):
    English DTS-HD Master Audio 5.1
    Russian DTS 5.1
    Spanish (Castilian) DTS 5.1
    Turkish Dolby Digital 5.1
  • Case type:
    Special Case
  • Notes:
    DISC ONE is region B+C, DISC TWO is region A+B, all other discs are region ALL.
    Disc eight and nine extras are in English with optional Danish, Dutch, English HoH, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin (Traditional), Norwegian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin), Swedish and Thai subtitles.
    The box includes Art of Prometheus exclusive book extracts.
  • Easter eggs:
    1) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Pre-Production", highlight "Cast Portrait Gallery", go right and press enter to access notes regarding the Nostromo flight plan and the crew.
    2) On disc 9, in "Alien"/"Production", highlight "H.R. Giger's Work Shop", go right and press enter to access notes regarding Kane's transmission of the Alien's lifecycle.
    3) On disc 9, in "Aliens"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Final Battle and Epilogue", go right and press enter to access "A Boy and His Power-Loader" featurette (9:36).
    4) On disc 9, in "Alien Resurrection"/"Production"/"Production Image Galleries", highlight "Extracting the Queen", go right and press enter to access an interview (6:48).

    OVERALL: Draw

    All 6-disc "Alien Anthology" releases for all 4 Alien films plus 2 bonus discs of extras. Only minor language differences between releases.

    All "Prometheus to Alien" 9-disc editions and the Japanese "H.R. Giger Tribute Collection" include the 3D Collector's Edition of "Prometheus" plus the 6-disc "Alien Anthology" set. Each release has minor language, region code, and limited collectible differences.

    The 2024 US/Canada releases have an exclusive documentary though it loses a few extras from the older Fox releases.

    Differences between the Theatrical Cut and Special Edition can be found at Movie-Censorship.

    Differences between the Special Edition DVD version and the Special Edition Blu-ray version can be found at Movie-Censorship.
